inputs.title: Distributed Transaction Ordering Protocol
inputs.problem: A software system needs deterministic transaction ordering without a single leader becoming a bottleneck.
inputs.solution: Nodes exchange threshold signatures over peer-to-peer channels and commit transactions in DAG order.
inputs.components: Gossip communication module, DAG ledger buffer, threshold signature verifier, and state committer.

inputs.title: Adaptive Compliant Gripper Assembly
inputs.problem: Rigid robotic grippers overload motors when grasping irregular mechanical workpieces.
inputs.solution: Tendon-driven fingers move through differential gearing with torsional spring compliance.
inputs.components: Mounting flange, planetary differential gear train, three articulated finger segments, and elastomer grip pads.

inputs.title: Dynamic Sparse Attention Neural Network
inputs.problem: Dense attention over high-frequency sensor streams consumes excessive memory and computation.
inputs.solution: A routing neural network assigns sensor tokens to top matching latent clusters before sparse attention.
inputs.components: Input encoder, routing neural network, sparse cross-attention layers, and linear projection head.
